generator: Administrative examples: actual Prabh Map Studio exportMap function, rasterized from SVG. Satellite example: static GIS composition using the same imagery service and local boundary files as the app. No source geometry changes.

examples.title: Delhi · districts and subdivisions
examples.note: LGD 2024 source: 11 districts and 34 subdivisions. Does not depict the December 2025 reorganization.

examples.title: Delhi · historical municipal detail
examples.note: Historical source: 272 MCD wards, 9 NDMC charges and 8 Cantonment charges; not the current 250-ward arrangement.

examples.title: Lahore Division · district and local detail
examples.note: Four source districts: Lahore, Kasur, Sheikhupura and Nankana Sahib. WFP/OCHA 2022 district and standard tehsil geometry. The 22 local-detail areas include 10 Lahore polygons from an unverified August 2025 upload, as labeled in app/catalog.json. Not a certified current administrative map.

examples.title: Lahore Division · union-council coverage
examples.note: Retained Alhasan Systems/HDX 2017-publication union-council coverage; source gaps remain visible. Not a current complete local-government register.

examples.title: Maharashtra · districts and subdistricts
examples.note: LGD 2024 source: 36 districts and 360 named subdistrict areas; one unnamed source record is excluded.

examples.title: Andaman & Nicobar · administrative detail
examples.note: LGD 2024 source: 3 districts and 9 named subdistrict areas. Actual geographic positions and relative scale are retained.

examples.title: Delhi · satellite and district boundaries
examples.generator: Esri World Imagery export in Web Mercator; local GeoJSON boundaries projected into the exact returned image extent. Documentation illustration, not a browser screenshot.
